title: Writing Transitions: Addition (B1)
titleReason: The original title 'Writing Transitions: Addition' is somewhat vague and doesn't clearly convey that the lesson focuses on specific vocabulary for addition transitions in writing. The suggested title is more explicit and engaging.
relevanceIssues: The Examples section includes sentences that demonstrate contrast and result transitions, which are off-topic for a lesson focused on addition transitions.
The How It Works section discusses various types of transitions (addition, contrast, example, result) instead of focusing solely on addition transitions.
The Practice Lab contains exercises that test contrast transitions rather than addition transitions.
changes: Title: "Writing Transitions: Addition (B1)" → "Using Addition Transitions in Writing"
